title: A Garden for the Tide
author: Elodie Nystrom
blurb: Ines Ravensworth, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
